_comment: Copy to config/dev.json (gitignored) and run with: flutter run --flavor dev --dart-define-from-file=config/dev.json. Every key is read with String.fromEnvironment, a compile-time constant: a missing key is an empty string, not an error, so keep names exact. Keys arrive with the features that read them (FLUTTER_ARCHITECTURE.md §9). Never put a password, signing key or server secret in any config file. FIREBASE_* values come from the Firebase console (project aa-12-step-guide, Project settings > Your apps; or `flutterfire configure` output): they are public identifiers kept out of git by choice (Q-T1). Leave them empty and analytics and crash reporting stay off. Dev uses the separate dev apps in the same project (bundle/package id ending .dev).
